issues.title: Signature field boundaries fall below 3:1 contrast
issues.evidence: Draw-pad border #c89b86 against #fae9e2 = 2.10:1; typed-input border #b99b83 against #fff9ee = 2.48:1. These low-contrast borders identify the otherwise similarly colored input areas.
issues.impact: Low-vision visitors can miss where to draw or type before they focus the field.
issues.standard: WCAG 2.1/2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA), component identification at rest
issues.recommendation: Darken the two functional field borders to at least 3:1; preserve the approved paper/art colors.

issues.title: Denied browser storage leaves the feedback route blank
issues.evidence: In a fresh context with Storage.getItem throwing SecurityError, /feedback produced an empty body and uncaught page error "Blocked in audit". Both language and space-ID state initializers read localStorage without a guard, before refresh error recovery can render.
issues.impact: A visitor with blocked storage loses the entire ideas page and its navigation/retry UI.
issues.standard: Robustness/error recovery; no specific WCAG conformance claim
issues.recommendation: Guard initialization and language persistence; render a localized storage-unavailable state using existing feedback error handling.

issues.title: Signing removes the focused button and drops focus to BODY
issues.evidence: After both typed and drawn acceptance, the answer button unmounts. Observed activeElement was BODY. Escape then reached the outer letter handler; the pact remained data-open=true. From a focused .pp-close button, Escape correctly closed the pact and restored focus to .pp-dolls.
issues.impact: Keyboard users lose their place after the emotional confirmation and Escape can act on the enclosing letter instead of the pact.
issues.standard: Focus-order/context concern related to WCAG SC 2.4.3; no complete conformance finding claimed
issues.recommendation: Move focus to the signed confirmation or another stable control on acceptance; keep Escape scoped to the active pact.

issues.title: Gallery arrival transfers large offscreen and miniature artwork
issues.evidence: Fresh /#games reduced-motion context transferred 39,917,571 bytes including dev runtime. Leonardo miniature alone transferred 5,329,269 bytes (source 5,328,969); city-windows PNG 2,852,599; two duel outcome PNGs about 2.02 MB each; several other PNGs 1–2 MB. Existing dist Landing bundle is 1,013,975 bytes / 300,760 gzip. These are measured asset sizes and local timings, not production Web Vitals.
issues.impact: The desktop gift can require substantial bandwidth before a visitor reaches or uses those details. Localhost timing hides network cost.
issues.recommendation: Serve appropriately sized compressed derivatives for miniature art and defer offscreen companions/outcomes until near view, retaining source assets and the approved art. Profile real hardware before making rendering claims.

issues.title: The typed-signature minimum is unexplained
issues.evidence: Typing A left the sign action disabled; Lisbeth enabled it. The label and described note explain that the name is stored as text, but do not explain the two-character minimum.
issues.impact: An initial or a valid one-character name appears to fail silently. This is a discoverability/validation issue, not a request to fabricate a signature.
issues.standard: Input instructions / error prevention; review SC 3.3.2 in product context
issues.recommendation: State the existing minimum beside the field, or intentionally permit a nonempty one-character name consistently in validation and persistence.

issues.title: Shared semantic colors are repeated as literals
issues.evidence: Feedback and post-hero have local variables, but the bounded CSS contains 594 hex color occurrences across gallery, hero, story and feedback. The count includes intentional illustration/material colors, so it is not 594 defects. Shared ink, paper, muted text and focus colors are still repeatedly authored directly.
issues.impact: Future contrast or palette adjustments require several component edits and can drift.
issues.recommendation: Extract only repeated semantic UI colors as future changes require them; preserve intentional art colors. No new dark mode is required by this gift brief.
